title: How to find the original price before a discount
task: Sale price and percent-off known — recover what it cost before.

excel.note: A2=sale price, B2=discount rate. Divide — don't multiply by (1+B2).

explanation: A 25%-off sale price is 75% of the original, so dividing by 0.75 reverses it: $60 / 0.75 = $80. The tempting shortcut — adding 25% back (60 × 1.25 = $75) — is wrong, because the percentage was taken of the LARGER original, not the sale price. Same logic recovers pre-tax amounts from totals (divide by 1+rate) — reverse percentages always divide.
